Package edu.harvard.hul.ois.fits.tools

Class ToolBase

  • java.lang.Object
    • edu.harvard.hul.ois.fits.tools.ToolBase
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Tool, Runnable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    ADLTool, AudioInfo, Droid, EmbARC, Exiftool, FFIdent, FileInfo, FileUtility, Jhove, Jpylyzer, MediaInfo, MetadataExtractor, TikaTool, VTTTool, XmlMetadata
    public abstract class ToolBase
